content.title: Audio Plugin GUI Layout Design & VST3 Guidelines
content.overview: Comprehensive layout design principles and VST3-specific implementation guidelines for professional audio plugin interfaces.

framework.name: VSTGUI Framework
framework.description: Official UI toolkit for VST3 plugins
features: Automatic Parameter Binding - seamless VST3 integration
Live Editing - VSTGUI_LIVE_EDITING=1 enables real-time editing

key_principles: Parameter Tags - map control IDs to VST3 parameters for automation
Template System - use nested templates for complex interfaces
Sub-Controllers - implement IVST3EditorDelegate for custom behavior
Responsive Sizing - support host resizing via IPlugViewContentScaleSupport

universal_design_principles.title: User-Centric Layout Design
universal_design_principles.description: Design layouts based on user workflow and frequency of use
guidelines: Streamline workflow - prioritize frequently used controls
Place primary controls in prime positions (top-left for Western audiences)
Create logical grouping for related parameters (e.g., filter section, envelope section)

universal_design_principles.title: Visual Hierarchy & Grid System
universal_design_principles.description: Apply grid-based layouts for organized, balanced interfaces
guidelines: Use modular grids (rule of thirds, golden ratio)
Size indicates importance - larger controls for higher priority

universal_design_principles.title: Control Selection & Metaphors
universal_design_principles.description: Choose appropriate controls that match parameter conceptual models
guidelines: Knobs for continuous parameters (frequency, gain, Q factor)
Use standard icons for recognition (sound waves for EQ)

universal_design_principles.title: Visual Feedback & State Awareness
universal_design_principles.description: Provide immediate, clear feedback for all user interactions
guidelines: Show parameter values with units (dB, Hz, ms)

universal_design_principles.title: Accessibility & Legibility
universal_design_principles.description: Ensure interface is usable by all users
guidelines: High contrast ratios (4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for UI components)

universal_design_principles.title: Aesthetic Consistency
guidelines: Cohesive color palette with defined primary, secondary, accent colors
Minimalist approach - every element serves a purpose

spatial_organization.description: Recommended spatial layout patterns for audio plugins

patterns.name: Classic Three-Section Layout
structure: Header: Plugin Name, Preset Browser, Global Controls
Middle: Main Parameter Sections (organized by function)

patterns.name: Synthesizer Layout
structure: Bottom: Envelopes, LFOs, and Master Controls

maximum_size.considerations: Support up to 4K displays without pixelation
maximum_size.implementation: Use vector graphics or high-resolution bitmaps

options: Lock aspect ratio for consistent layout
Provide scalable vector graphics for flexibility

scaling_approaches: Dynamic layout that adapts to size changes

efficient_rendering: Use bitmap caching for static elements
performance_optimization.lazy_loading: Load heavy visualizations only when visible
performance_optimization.frame_rate: Maintain 60fps for smooth animations and interactions
performance_optimization.threading: Keep UI updates on message thread, audio processing on audio thread

common_pitfalls: Overcrowding - too many controls in limited space
Inconsistent behavior - knobs that behave like sliders
Poor contrast - low visibility in different lighting
Ignoring host integration - not supporting host features
Unscalable graphics - raster images that blur at high DPI
Cluttered interface - too many visual elements competing
Inconsistent spacing - makes interface feel unpolished

vst3_specific: Use VSTGUI::VST3Editor for proper VST3 integration
Implement IParameterFinder for host parameter search
Support IContextMenu for host right-click menus
Test on multiple hosts (Cubase, Live, Logic, Pro Tools)
general: Optimize for both light and dark DAW themes
Ensure all controls provide visual feedback
Verify performance with all animations active

sections.header: Plugin name, preset browser, bypass button

host_compatibility: Test in major DAWs (Pro Tools, Logic, Cubase, Ableton Live, FL Studio)
Test window resizing in different hosts
accessibility_testing: Use screen readers to verify label descriptions
Check font scaling at system level
performance_testing: Measure CPU usage with UI open vs closed
Test with maximum number of instances
Verify no audio dropouts during heavy UI interaction
Check memory usage over extended sessions
